title: CORD receipt label schema (30 classes)
notes: src/receipt.txt quotes the README 'Class Definition (total 30)' table verbatim. The 30 non-struck tags become string leaves under menu[] (14), void_menu[] (2), subtotal (6), total (8), with the README descriptions. Struck-out tags (menu.sub_num, voidtotal.*, etc.) omitted per README. Key naming follows the README table ('subtotal', 'void_menu'); the HF CORD v1/v2 gt_parse uses 'sub_total' and nests submenus under menu[].sub, which the README table does not document, so sub_* fields stay flat on menu items. The 'Json Hierarchy' (valid_line/meta/roi OCR annotation format) is not a parse-label schema and was not transcribed.

title: CUAD 41 clause categories
notes: Source list is category_descriptions.csv (the repo readme has no category list); src/contract.txt is the CSV bytes verbatim (UTF-8 BOM kept). Licence: the GitHub repo has no licence file; the CUAD dataset is CC BY 4.0 per atticusprojectai.org/cuad and the HF dataset cards (theatticusproject/cuad, cuad-qa). Keys are snake_case of the category name; 'title' = official name; x-cuad-answer-format / x-cuad-group carry the CSV columns. String-typed per CSV answer format: Document Name, Agreement Date, Effective Date, Expiration Date, Renewal Term, Notice Period to Terminate Renewal, Governing Law, Warranty Duration ('Number of months or years'); Parties = array of strings. Document Name and Warranty Duration are non-Yes/No in the CSV although not in the brief's list. 'Affiliate License-Licensee' has an empty answer format in the CSV; typed boolean, as it is a yes/no license category in the CUAD paper.

title: JSON Resume schema v1.0.0
notes: URL taken from the 'JSON Resume' entry of https://www.schemastore.org/api/json/catalog.json (v1.0.0, tag commit 7095651fbbb593d2c5dc2db3095412b170d74d2e). Saved byte-for-byte. It declares draft-04 ($schema draft-04, 'definitions'); it uses no draft-04-only keywords (no boolean exclusiveMinimum, no 'id'), so it evaluates the same under a 2020-12 validator. The repo's master schema.json is a later draft-07 revision (not used).

title: Health record (json-schema.org 'JSON Schema examples')
notes: Rendered page: https://json-schema.org/learn/json-schema-examples (section 'Health record'). The schema is the page's ```json code block copied byte-for-byte. It has emergencyContact: {$ref: https://example.com/user-profile.schema.json}; that $id belongs to the 'User profile' example on the same page, saved verbatim as src/medical_intake.user-profile.schema.json so a validator registry can resolve it offline. No patient-intake Pydantic model was found in Instructor, LangChain/LangGraph or LlamaIndex docs/examples (searched Instructor docs+examples, langchain-ai/docs, llama_index docs tree, llama_cloud_services examples); schemastore only has gematik test-patient lists, so this json-schema.org example was used. Repo licence: README says 'BSD 3-clause license or the Academic Free License v3.0' (GitHub reports NOASSERTION).
